# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately through GitHub: open the **Security** tab of this repository and choose **Report a vulnerability**. You will get a reply within 7 days. Once a fix is released, you will be credited in the changelog unless you prefer not to be.

This package reads files that users upload into an admin panel. Reports about file parsing (resource exhaustion, encoding tricks), the failed-rows download link, tenant isolation and formula injection are especially welcome.
